description: Template for releasing a new version with quality gates

steps.title: Preparar CHANGELOG para v{{version}}
steps.description: Actualizar CHANGELOG.md con los cambios incluidos en v{{version}}. {{description}}

steps.title: Rust: Bump version a {{version}}
steps.description: Actualizar Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock y kn.toml a version {{version}}.

steps.title: Security: Audit pre-release v{{version}}
steps.description: Ejecutar Trivy, Semgrep y Gitleaks sobre el codigo a liberar. Verificar que no hay vulnerabilidades criticas.

steps.title: QA: Smoke tests pre-release v{{version}}
steps.description: Ejecutar smoke tests: kn doctor, kn update, instalacion limpia. Verificar funcionalidad basica.

steps.title: Gate: Aprobacion de release v{{version}}

gate.description: Verificacion final antes de publicar v{{version}}

steps.description: Gate de aprobacion humana. Verificar que security audit y QA smoke tests pasaron.

steps.title: DevOps: Publicar release v{{version}}
steps.description: Crear tag, trigger GitHub Actions release workflow, verificar artefactos publicados.
